A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the exhausted T cell response in HBV is not only characterised by a lack of co-stimulation, but also by the absence of signal 3, which is provided by IL-12 in normal T cells.
the exhausted CD8 response to HBV is characterised by a loss of cytokine production and a reduction in polyfunctionality and that these functional deficits are rescued by IL-12.
